panels.title: Kafka Intake Status
panels.description: Current Kafka append-path status across API replicas. Healthy = 1, Unavailable = 0.

panels.title: PostgreSQL Primary
panels.description: Writable primary reachability through Pgpool. Active = 1, Unavailable = 0.

panels.title: Worker Status
panels.description: Kubernetes Worker available/desired ratio. Available = 1, Unavailable = 0; partial ratios remain numeric. Replica counts are shown in Worker Replicas.

panels.title: PostgreSQL Standbys
panels.description: Current ready PostgreSQL standby count after deduplicating API replica observations. Local HA target = 2.

panels.title: API Request Rate
panels.description: API request rate by HTTP status. 2xx = green, 4xx = yellow, 5xx = red.

panels.title: API 5xx Ratio
panels.description: User-visible server error ratio. Yellow >= 1%, red >= 5%.

panels.title: API Latency
panels.description: API response latency. Worker persistence is measured separately.

panels.title: API Stage Latency
panels.description: Hot-path stage latency such as membership, idempotency, and Kafka publish.

panels.title: Worker Throughput By Result
panels.description: Worker event processing rate by result.

panels.title: Worker Failure Ratio
panels.description: Core Worker processing failure ratio. Yellow >= 1%, red >= 5%.

panels.title: API Queue To DB Commit
panels.description: End-to-end persistence lag from the API queued_at timestamp, captured before Kafka append, to PostgreSQL commit return. Includes queue wait, Worker processing, DB work, and inline retry.

panels.title: API Queue To Worker Start
panels.description: Pre-processing wait from the API queued_at timestamp, captured before Kafka append, to Worker handler start. This is a queue/backlog proxy and includes Kafka publish time.

panels.title: Worker Stage Latency
panels.description: Worker stage bottlenecks such as db_persist and status update.

panels.title: Worker Last Success Age
panels.description: Seconds since last successful worker job.

panels.title: DB Pool In Use
panels.description: Total checked-out DB connections across replicas, grouped by workload.

panels.title: DB Failure Reasons (15m)
panels.description: DB failures grouped by reason over 15 minutes.

panels.title: DLQ Events And Replay
panels.description: DLQ inflow and replay guard outcomes.

panels.title: PostgreSQL Replication Delay
panels.description: Maximum standby replication delay after deduplicating API replica observations.

panels.title: PostgreSQL Replication States
panels.description: Conservative replication state counts after deduplicating API replica observations.

panels.title: Worker Scaling
panels.description: KEDA desired worker replicas versus available replicas.

panels.title: API Scaling
panels.description: API HPA desired replicas versus available replicas.

panels.title: Pod Restarts (15m)
panels.description: Restart signal for CrashLoopBackOff, OOMKilled, and resource pressure.

panels.title: Unavailable Replicas
panels.description: Unavailable deployment replicas from rollout, scheduling, or readiness issues.

options.content:
### DLQ operator links

- DLQ summary API: `GET /v1/dlq/ingress/summary?limit=200&sample_limit=5`
- Recent DLQ samples: `GET /v1/dlq/ingress?limit=20`
- Runbook: `docs/RUNBOOK.md#dlq-summary-triage`

Use the summary API after `DLQ Events And Replay` changes to split failures by `by_reason`, `replayable`, `blocked`, `oldest_sample_age_seconds`, and `by_stream`. `oldest_sample_age_seconds` is the age of the oldest record in the bounded sample, not total unresolved-backlog age or an SLO measurement.

panels.title: Kafka Broker Count
panels.description: Broker count reported directly by kafka-exporter.

panels.title: Kafka Consumer Group Lag
panels.description: Total direct kafka-exporter lag for each persistence or notification consumer group.

panels.title: Kafka Topic Partitions
panels.description: Partition count by Kafka topic from kafka-exporter.
